coder_notes: Chloroquine added to Stupp (RT + TMZ) vs Stupp alone; control arm is registered NO_INTERVENTION, so control_arm_from_other_arms = no. The [18F]HX4 hypoxia PET is used in a single-centre substudy only and is not a registered intervention, so it is not listed as an agent (R9). Target engagement coded yes: paired HX4-PET before and one week after CQ start measures tumour hypoxia, the stated downstream effect of autophagy inhibition. EGFRvIII (exploratory correlative only) coded candidate_matched true because the record's rationale links EGFRvIII-driven autophagy dependence to chloroquine; it is not an eligibility/enrichment biomarker, so it does not affect the primary outcome. cns5: IDH wildtype required (also 'glioblastoma multiforme') -> cns5.
